concept.literalSynthesis: A wand of vampire spark bound in the seams of a stitched vampire suit, with a red ember set into its head.
concept.coreMechanic: Primary use launches one cursor-aimed, 12-damage magic ember at 26.25 blocks/s. The ember follows a downward gravity arc, lasts 1.5 seconds, and heals its owner for 10% of damage dealt on a hit, capped at 1 HP per hit. The reusable wand keeps the source wand's 26-tick use interval and 4-mana base cost; native mana is attempted when a use animation starts. When equipped as an accessory, it grants 2 defense and +1 HP/s life regeneration. These are separate functions: defense and regeneration require equipping it, while casting requires using it. Both parents are generation-depth zero; no further progression tier is inferred.
concept.parentAContribution: The vampire-spark wand contributes the red ember identity and a deliberate magic shot: its observed parent shot deals 12 magic damage, travels at 7 pixels per tick, uses a 26-tick interval and costs 4 mana. Its supplied runtime also shows a gravity arc and a small on-hit owner heal; those mechanics are kept at their observed scale.
concept.parentBContribution: The stitched vampire suit contributes the stitched vampire identity and the equipped accessory role. Its observed accessory has +1 HP/s regeneration and +5% movement speed but no defense; this synthesis adds modest defense as a new, explicit benefit rather than attributing it to the parent.
concept.playerExperience: Cast a modest, single-hit ember on the wand's 26-tick cadence, paying its 4-mana base cost at animation start. Hits provide at most 1 HP of healing. Equipping the wand adds 2 defense and +1 HP/s regeneration; holding it grants neither passive bonus.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Cast one cursor-aimed gravity ember; a damaging hit returns a small capped amount of life.
Wear the wand as an accessory for its explicit defense and life-regeneration bonuses.

realization.description: Use the wand to cast one red-lit vampire ember toward the cursor. Each use launches a 12-damage magic projectile with a downward gravity arc; it can hit once and lasts up to 1.5 seconds. A hit heals 10% of damage dealt, up to 1 HP. The wand has a 26-tick use interval and a 4-mana base cost paid by Terraria when the use animation starts. Equip it as an accessory to gain 2 defense and +1 HP/s life regeneration. These equipment bonuses apply while worn, not while the wand is merely held.
realization.playerExperience: A reusable magic shot with a small hit-triggered heal; the healing is capped at 1 HP per hit. The accessory adds modest defense and regeneration in exchange for occupying an accessory slot.
